items.title: uv add with authentication appropriately doesn't store the secret, but should store the username
items.reason: Tracks the same username loss when `uv add` saves a Git source, preventing later access with the intended identity. Its reproduction uses HTTPS; this SSH case reaches the same credential-removal code.

items.title: Preserve Git username for SSH dependencies
items.reason: Introduced username preservation in Git serialization, including `uv add`. The implementation and maintainer explanation explicitly limit preservation to password-free SSH URLs with username `git`, leaving custom usernames outside the fix.

items.title: Don't redact username `git` for SSH
items.reason: Fixed astral-sh/uv#13795 in uv 0.7.10 by preserving literal `git` during SSH URL display and extending credential-removal handling to `git+ssh`. It did not preserve arbitrary SSH usernames.

related.search_scope: Searched astral-sh/uv open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged pull requests using authenticated gh. Literal searches covered SSH usernames being dropped, `uv add`, `mygituser`, and uv 0.12.23. Conceptual searches covered username storage/persistence, stripping/redaction, custom SSH users, Git authentication, and subsequent updates without package or platform constraints. Fix-oriented searches covered username preservation, `remove_credentials`, and `is_ssh_git_username`; inspected linked discussions, PR patches, and release notes. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#13795 and astral-sh/uv#14147 as exact duplicates because they concern historical masking of literal `git`; astral-sh/uv#6420 concerns old tool receipts, and astral-sh/uv#8529 requests broader authentication configuration.

type_reason: astral-sh/uv#15034 already tracks losing a required Git username when `uv add` saves a source URL. Historical fixes in astral-sh/uv#6335 and astral-sh/uv#13799 only preserve literal `git`; no regression of custom-username support is established.
summary: astral-sh/uv#15034 is the closest existing report; historical SSH fixes preserve only `git`. The requested README update could not be completed because $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md is on a read-only filesystem.
